mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, project_id, monomer_id, area_id, bool_status_enum,bool_abnormal_enum, name, serial_number, specification, length, material, quantity, net_weight, total_net_weight, gross_weight, total_gross_weight, surface_area, drawing_number, remark,user_id, business_id, produced_quantity,area_type,smart_line_mark_word,artifact_type
mapper.select: select IFNULL(sum(total_net_weight), 0) as total_net_weight, IFNULL(sum(total_gross_weight), 0) as total_gross_weight from tech_artifact where area_id = #{areaId} and bool_delete_enum = 0

select m.`id` 'monomer.id', m.`name` 'monomer.name', ifnull(sum(a.quantity), 0) quantity, ROUND( ifnull( sum( a.surface_area * a.quantity ), 0 ) / 1000000, 4 ) AS total_area, ROUND( ifnull( sum( a.top_flange_area * a.quantity ), 0 ) / 1000000, 4 ) AS top_flange_area, ifnull(sum(a.total_drawing_weight), 0) AS total_drawing_weight, ifnull(sum(a.total_net_weight), 0) total_net_weight, ifnull(sum(a.total_gross_weight), 0) total_gross_weight
from tech_artifact a inner join plan_monomer m on m.id = a.monomer_id and m.bool_delete_enum = 0
INNER JOIN sys_monomer_user_link AS link ON m.id = link.monomer_id AND link.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND link.deepened_person_id = #{userId}
where a.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.project_id = #{projectId} group by m.id

select d.`id` 'area.id', d.`name` 'area.name', ifnull(sum(a.quantity), 0) quantity, ifnull(sum(a.total_net_weight), 0) total_net_weight, ifnull(sum(a.total_gross_weight), 0) total_gross_weight, ROUND( ifnull( sum( a.surface_area * a.quantity ), 0 ) / 1000000, 4 ) AS total_area, ROUND( ifnull( sum( a.top_flange_area * a.quantity ), 0 ) / 1000000, 4 ) AS top_flange_area, ifnull(sum(a.total_drawing_weight), 0) AS total_drawing_weight from tech_artifact a inner join plan_area d on d.id = a.area_id and d.bool_delete_enum = 0 where a.bool_delete_enum = 0
and a.area_id in
#{areaId}
group by d.id
select id from tech_artifact where bool_delete_enum = 0 and area_id = #{areaId}

SELECT sc.classification_name, sc.id classificationId, ta.material, ta.artifact_type, IFNULL(sum(ta.quantity), 0) quantity, IFNULL(sum(ta.total_gross_weight), 0) totalGrossWeight, IFNULL(sum(ta.total_net_weight), 0) totalNetWeight FROM (SELECT structure_class_id, material, production_line_type_enum, artifact_type, SUM(quantity) quantity, SUM(total_gross_weight) total_gross_weight, SUM(total_net_weight) total_net_weight FROM tech_artifact WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND bool_delete_enum = 0 GROUP BY structure_class_id, production_line_type_enum, material, artifact_type) AS ta LEFT JOIN sys_structure_classification AS sc ON ta.structure_class_id = sc.id AND sc.bool_delete_enum = 0 GROUP BY sc.classification_name, sc.id, ta.material, ta.artifact_type ORDER BY ta.artifact_type ASC, sc.id ASC

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(ms.scheduling_quantity * ta.net_weight),0) allocationWeight, IFNULL(SUM(ms.complete_quantity * ta.net_weight),0) completionWeight, IFNULL(SUM((ms.scheduling_quantity - ms.complete_quantity) * ta.net_weight),0) unCompletionWeight, MAX(ask_complete_time) FROM `mes_building_scheduling` ms
LEFT JOIN tech_artifact ta ON ms.product_id = ta.id and ta.bool_delete_enum = 0
LEFT JOIN tech_assemble ta ON ms.product_id = ta.id and ta.bool_delete_enum = 0
LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part ta ON ms.product_id = ta.id and ta.bool_delete_enum = 0
LEFT JOIN tech_enclosure ta ON ms.product_id = ta.id and ta.bool_delete_enum = 0
WHERE ms.project_id = #{projectId} AND ms.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND ms.production_line_id = #{lineId} AND ms.product_type = #{type}

select
initial_serial_number AS serial_number
serial_number
from
tech_artifact
tech_assemble
tech_machine_part
WHERE bool_delete_enum=0
and id=#{productId}

SELECT cp.id 'project.id', cp.NAME 'project.name', cp.serial_number 'project.serialNumber', cp.short_name 'project.shortName', pm.id 'monomer.id', pm.`name` 'monomer.name', pa.id 'area.id', pa.`name` 'area.name', a.id, a.name, a.serial_number, a.specification, a.material, a.quantity, a.user_id 'user.id', u.username 'user.name' FROM tech_artifact a LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.id = a.project_id LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON pm.id = a.monomer_id LEFT JOIN plan_area pa ON pa.id = a.area_id WHERE a.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND a.id = #{productId}
select ifnull(round(sum((ifnull(a.quantity, 0) * ifnull(a.net_weight, 0)) / 1000), 2), 0) as ton from tech_artifact a where a.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT art.id 'artifactId', par.id 'assOrPartId', par.bool_process 'boolProcess' FROM tech_artifact art LEFT JOIN tech_artifact_machine_part_link link ON art.id = link.artifact_id LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part par ON link.machine_part_id = par.id WHERE art.id IN
#{artifactId}

SELECT art.id 'artifactId', par.id 'assOrPartId', par.bool_process 'boolProcess' FROM tech_artifact art LEFT JOIN tech_assemble_detail link ON art.id = link.artifact_id LEFT JOIN tech_assemble ass ON link.assemble_id = ass.id WHERE art.id IN
#{artifactId}
SELECT sum(total_net_weight) FROM tech_artifact WHERE project_id in (#{projectId}) AND bool_delete_enum = 0

SELECT cp.id 'project.id', cp.NAME 'project.name', cp.serial_number 'project.serialNumber', cp.short_name 'project.shortName', pm.id 'monomer.id', pm.`name` 'monomer.name', pa.id 'area.id', pa.`name` 'area.name', a.id, a.*, ssc.classification_name 'structureClassify.name', ssc.id 'structureClassify.id' FROM tech_artifact a LEFT JOIN contract_project cp ON cp.id = a.project_id LEFT JOIN plan_monomer pm ON pm.id = a.monomer_id LEFT JOIN plan_area pa ON pa.id = a.area_id LEFT JOIN sys_structure_classification ssc ON ssc.id = a.structure_class_id WHERE a.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND a.id =#{id}
